matchingFinding.description: A short quote or paraphrase of the tester finding that matches, if any.

detectionSource.description: The session notes tag each finding with its source, e.g. '(source: deterministic)' or '(source: ai)'. Report which source(s) produced the matching finding; use 'n/a' only for a MISSED verdict.

isRealButUnseededDefect.description: True if this looks like a genuine defect that just isn't in the seeded fault catalog (not a false positive in the harsh sense), false if it's simply wrong/not a defect.
